claims.quote: The zoot suit originated in African American comedy shows within the Chitlin' Circuit in the 1920s.

There was no one designer in creating the zoot suits; however, many tailors have taken credit for the definitive style and capitalized on it. Harold C. Fox, a Chicago clothier and big-band trumpeter; Charles Klein and Vito Bagnato of New York City; Louis Lettes, a Memphis tailor; and Nathan (Toddy) Elkus, a Detroit retailer.
